sourceTitle: A Theory of Creation: A Review of 'Vestiges of the Natural History of Creation'
description: "A Theory of Creation: A Review of 'Vestiges of the Natural History of Creation'" is a scientific critique written in the mid-19th century. This work critically examines the theories put forth in "Vestiges of the Natural History of Creation,” addressing the origins of life and the universe through a lens of skepticism towards speculative science.
